# Package `ffi`

```go
package ffi
```

Package ffi provides the low-level host call boundary used by optional capability libraries. Payloads are opaque to the compiler and VM.

- [func Call](#func-call)

## Variables

### var ErrRouteUnavailable

```go
var ErrRouteUnavailable = errors.New("FFI route unavailable")
```

ErrRouteUnavailable means no host implementation is installed for the route.

## Functions

### func Call

```go
func Call(route string, payload []byte) ([]byte, error)
```

Call invokes one host route. It blocks the calling Mini-Go goroutine while allowing unrelated VM work to continue.
